blocks.text: CONTINUING PROPHECY— ‘‘According to the scriptures God Himself predicted dates concerning the future!’’ — ‘‘He set a date for Israel to come out of Egypt . . . and the termination of Israel’s captivity in Babylon!’’ — ‘‘He told Abraham when He would destroy Sodom! . . . He told Noah when the flood would be! . . . He gave Daniel the date for the coming of the Messiah!’’ (Dan. 9:25-27) — “‘And in our time He will reveal many events of the future to us! — The exact date of the Translation will be hidden, but not the season!”’ — ‘‘When the elect body becomes one in unity and faith — He will reveal much concerning the future!’’ — Rev. 19:10, ‘‘The testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy . . . the spirit of the future and of things to come!”’

ROME IN PROPHECY— ‘‘Will Rome and the Vatican be destroyed in the future? Yes! — Evidently before this the religious location will be moved, the Pope, etc. I feel that the part concerning destruction will take place after the mark of the beast. It is associated to the ecclesiastical religious side of the beast! — The Bible locates it on seven mountains!’’ (Rev. 17:9) — ‘‘ ‘A double meaning’. . . at the end it will be a mixture of all religions that flow into it! . . . The Catholic Church and false religions will be purged in a fiery cataclysm before the Battle of Armageddon!’’. . . ‘‘Now Commercial Babylon is world wide and is found in Rev. chap. 18 — and it will live its time out until the Battle of Armageddon and the doom of the anti-christ!’’ (Verses 8-10) — “‘It is my opinion that all of this could definitely take place before the ending of the 90’s!’”’

PROPHECY CONCERNING ISRAEL— ‘‘No doubt Israel will make some peace agreements with several Arab nations in the 80’s, but be not deceived, this peace will not last!’’ — ‘‘Finally Israel will make an agreement with the false messiah. It will be a covenant of protection and peace amongst surrounding nations! — This evidently will be some time later after Halley’s Comet and may even be as long as the early stages of the 90’s. Of course we know from the signs that it can take place sooner!”’

PROPHETIC QUESTION— Some partners write me and ask, ‘‘is the anti-christ alive and on earth now?’’ — ‘‘Yes indeed! — Not only that, but he is working in certain events. Several of these things have been reported on the news, but the nations do not know that he is the cause of it!’ — ‘‘Also I foresee other events that he has caused plus some of them that he is going to do in the future! — And I will reveal this later!’’ . . . ‘‘His presence will be felt more often in the 80’s; he will finally be manifested and shew forth his plans more publicly!’’ — Here are three things to remember! — ‘‘He will have a Temple to sit in!’’ (II Thess. 2:4) — ‘‘He will have a great fortress or stronghold controlling all type new weapons of mass destruction! (Dan. 11:36-40) — ‘‘While he calls for disarming of others, he himself will have stored up tremendous forces of energy weapons!’’ — ‘‘He will also have a type of moveable Tabernacle (ver. 45) that he evidently uses especially in the Middle East to sell his propaganda! — They will wander after him from place to place! . . . The real rendering for the Tabernacle of his palace is a palatial tent! — Some type religious altar and setting! — He also will probably have a great jet air cruiser, a private new type ship and submarine palace with the latest and newest devices that are not even known of today! (futuristic)

CONTINUING EVENTS— ‘‘The anti-christ at first will use false religion to try to persecute and destroy true religion, including the true Hebrews and set up the mark of the beast. — Then he himself will turn on false religion and destroy it, leaving him in total control just before the Battle of Armageddon wherein he meets his own doom!”’ (Rev. 19) — ‘‘Also during the decade ahead we will see new structures and new building designs! . . . While the world holds on to some of the past there will still be revolutionary changes in this and in transportation, buying, selling, working, etc.! — ‘‘I foresee, by prophecy, a new type money coming!’’ — “‘A futuristic fantasy world appears. I foresee the changes in the mind and in the way people think and look will be incredible!’’ — ‘‘Also during this time the United States will suffer its greatest earthquake; the only way to describe it is a real cataclysm in death, shambles and destruction! . . . Also later in the age there will be great civil unrest and riots in the U.S.A.!’’

THE FUTURE CONCERNING IMMORALS— ‘In a moment we will be speaking about some important events, but let us check this that appeared in a magazine. (Some of this was similar to what was printed on the Scrolls as long as 15 years ago!) — The experts foresee for the later 80’s and 90’s . . . quote: ‘‘One doctor says more children will be conceived in artificial wombs!’’ . . . ‘‘Males will be sterilized after making a deposit at a sperm bank! — Then after having all the pleasure they want without children they can return, unfreeze the sperm at an older age and have children by a younger woman! . . . One doctor sees in the 90’s human reproduction under complete control with frozen eggs, sperm and embryos available from banks for births which would occur via human or artificial wombs!’’ — ‘‘He says before the ending of the 90’s marriage will no longer be protected by law!’’ — ‘‘One says by 1992 people won’t feel guilty about self-intercourse (using all types of aids) and pre-marital sex will be looked upon as a healthy outlook! — Also probably by that time people will have 3-dimensional sex with a fantasy figure or holographic image!’’ — ‘‘They go on to say millions will quit orthodox religions unless churches change their attitudes toward sex! . . . He sees also a high percentage of adultery and pre-marital sex! . . . He predicts that within a few years laws will allow adults to do whatever they want in private. And that homosexuals will become a stronger force in the community, and bisexuality will become fashionable! — And later homosexuals will not even be an issue! . . . And that also civil laws will cease trying to regulate sexual behaviour in consenting adults! . . . Also later in the age it will be popular for a woman to live with another woman and a man, and vice versa!’’? — ‘‘The lustful desires within them will call for it!’’

THE FUTURE— ‘By 1995 he says half of all Americans between 18 and 40 will be either single, never married, divorced or widowed! — Also there will be more sexually open communities and groups of 3 to 7 adults living together. And what the teenagers do will be beyond this!’’ (end quote) . . . “‘Jesus Himself even predicted worse conditions than this will finally take place! — He likened it as unto the days of Noah and of Sodom!”’ — ‘Although some of these events may seem bizarre and strange, most they imagine will take place! — Also from time to time there will be breathers where people will not be quite so bad, but each time it will return to even worse conditions! People will actually have intercourse with familiar spirits and idols entering the Great Tribulation!”’

DID YOU KNOW?— Quote: ‘‘In some U.S. cities, having a Biblestudy in your home would be against the law!’’. . . ‘‘Sexually perverse and bloody witchcraft rituals are now protected by law!’’. . . ‘‘With kiddie porn on the rise, one extremist group is calling for the age of sexual consent to be lowered to age 4!’’. . . ‘‘Your tax money is supporting an annual dance festival consistently featuring total nudity!’’ . .. ‘And that prostitution is being claimed as a woman’s legal right by the National Organization for Women in New York State!’’

COMING SUBJECTS— This is only part of some of the events that will be put on future Scrolls and/or in a book. — ‘‘Where or who is the false prophet? Will he rise from New York, L.A. or Washington, D.C.?’’. . . ““Will Washington, D.C. and its leader be destroyed by 1996-99 or sooner?’’ . . . ‘‘Later in the age, will the United States Constitution be totally changed?’’ . . . ‘‘Is the Pope different from the anti-christ? Or does the anti-christ assume that position along with world rule?’’ . . . ‘‘Will huge islands rise up out of the Atlantic Sea?’’ . . . ‘Will heat underneath crack the earth in many places in the 90’s’’ . .. “Will new weapons rise?’’ . . . ‘What about the 3 deadly rays?’’ .. . “Could the rapture take place in the 80’s or 90’s?’’ Season given, not exact date! . . . ‘‘When will the axis of the earth shift or tumble?’’ . . . ‘Will we have a U.S.A. president who goes insane or one that commits suicide?’’ . . . ‘“Will the 80’s or 90’s see the new electronic highway?’’ . . . ‘Will the Catholic state and Babylon religions control the U.S.A. before or in the 90’s?’’ . . . ‘‘How great will become the miracles of healing?’’ . . . ‘‘And how will, and by what manner, will God visit His people?’’ — ‘‘No matter what happens during the age, God’s hand will be upon His people! — There are yet many more future events that are not listed here, and it will be a while before we return and explain all of these subjects!’’ — ‘‘May the hand of the Lord Jesus be with you in all that you do, for He has some wonderful things ahead for His people. Praise Him!’’
